guardianInfoDescription: A Guardian is an independent service that cosigns every transaction from your wallet, adding a safety net without giving up self-custody.
guardianInfoWhatItDoesDescription: Co-signs every transaction — neither your device nor the Guardian can move funds alone. Helps you recover your account if you lose your device.
guardianInfoWhatItCannotDoDescription: Move your funds on its own. Access your private state. See your balances unless you share them.
guardianInfoSwitchingIsEasyDescription: You can switch to a different Guardian at any time with your recovery phrase. Only who co-signs changes; your account and funds stay the same.

Below are your cold private key plus both public keys. To reveal the device private key, use Settings → Reveal Device Key.
